scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && node scripts/build-windows-launcher.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter=tap --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=Temp/automation-scratch/package-test.tap tests/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke: node scripts/mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/bookkeeping-mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/orphan-lease-mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/failed-begin-mcp-smoke.mjs && node scripts/storage-mcp-smoke.mjs
